content: IndexedDB is the standard choice for local-first habit trackers over localStorage. IndexedDB handles structured data, larger volumes (years of completion logs), indexing by habitId+date, and async writes without blocking UI. localStorage is limited to ~5MB, synchronous, and string-only — suitable only for tiny prototypes. Dexie.js wraps IndexedDB with promise-based API, schema versioning, and useLiveQuery for reactive UI. Multiple open-source habit trackers (smart-habit-tracker, jcortesdev/habit-tracker) use Dexie as sole persistence layer.
